name: HumanNeRF-SE
definition: A method for synthesizing novel pose images of humans from monocular video inputs by combining explicit SMPL shape priors with implicit NeRF representation to avoid overfitting and reduce computational complexity.
summary: HumanNeRF-SE synthesizes novel human poses from monocular video by combining frozen SMPL weights with implicit NeRF, reducing overfitting and computational cost compared to prior methods.
